columns.name: crew_agreement
columns.reason: Standing employment/share arrangement on the vessel, fixed before the prediction point.

columns.name: traceability_vendor
columns.reason: Supply-chain traceability supplier is a static commercial attribute known in advance.

columns.name: next_survey_index_delta
columns.reason: Explicitly the next survey's change, which is only measured after the prediction point.

columns.name: assessment_ssb_below_blim
columns.reason: Stock biomass falling below Blim is the formal trigger used to justify an emergency closure.

columns.name: insurer
columns.reason: Insurance provider is a pre-existing contractual attribute of the vessel.

columns.name: build_decade
columns.reason: Construction decade is fixed at build and never changes.

columns.name: post_closure_effort_reallocation
columns.reason: Records how effort moved after a closure, so it exists only once the outcome occurred.

columns.name: assessment_recruitment_failure
columns.reason: Assessment finding of recruitment failure is an input to the closure determination itself.

columns.name: coastal_zone
columns.reason: Geographic zone assignment is a stable descriptor.

columns.name: processor_group
columns.reason: Processing buyer group is a standing commercial relationship.

columns.name: survey_index_decline_flag
columns.reason: Reads as a prior monitoring signal observable before any decision, though it may feed the advice.

columns.name: vessel_length_band
columns.reason: Registered length band is a fixed vessel characteristic.

columns.name: discard_rate
columns.reason: Operational discard statistic from routine monitoring, normally known before the decision.

columns.name: landings_index_prior_year
columns.reason: Explicitly the prior year's value, hence complete before prediction.

columns.name: vms_provider
columns.reason: Vessel monitoring system supplier is a pre-existing service contract.

columns.name: port_group
columns.reason: Home/landing port grouping is a stable registry attribute.

columns.name: licence_class
columns.reason: Licence category is issued and recorded before the season.

columns.name: fleet_capacity_kw
columns.reason: Registered engine capacity is a fixed fleet register value.

columns.name: hull_material
columns.reason: Construction material is fixed at build.

columns.name: decommissioning_compensation_eur
columns.reason: Compensation amount is settled after the conservation action, not before it.

columns.name: mean_length_cm
columns.reason: Biological size indicator from existing sampling, available before the decision.

columns.name: engine_class
columns.reason: Engine category is a fixed registered characteristic.

columns.name: quota_year
columns.reason: The management year is known at the moment of prediction.

columns.name: auction_house
columns.reason: Sales venue is a standing commercial relationship.

columns.name: producer_org
columns.reason: Producer organisation membership is recorded before the season.

columns.name: flag_state
columns.reason: Registration state is a fixed administrative attribute.

columns.name: safety_class
columns.reason: Safety certification category is assigned by prior inspection.

columns.name: refit_year_band
columns.reason: Last refit period is a historical fact recorded before prediction.

columns.name: ices_division
columns.reason: Statistical management area is a fixed spatial label.

columns.name: mesh_class
columns.reason: Permitted gear mesh category is set by licence before fishing.

columns.name: management_plan
columns.reason: The plan in force is established policy known ahead of the decision.

columns.name: effort_days_at_sea
columns.reason: Recorded fishing effort from logbooks, normally available before the closure decision.

columns.name: gear_type
columns.reason: Gear used is a declared, pre-existing operational attribute.

columns.name: fuel_contract
columns.reason: Fuel supply arrangement is a standing commercial contract.

columns.name: observer_scheme
columns.reason: Which observer programme applies is set before the season.

columns.name: marine_reserve
columns.reason: Protected-area designation is standing spatial regulation.

columns.name: ice_supplier
columns.reason: Ice supply vendor is an unrelated standing commercial relationship.

columns.name: certification_scheme
columns.reason: Sustainability certification held is recorded before the prediction point.

columns.name: logbook_system
columns.reason: Reporting system in use is a pre-existing administrative attribute.

columns.name: observer_coverage_uplift_days
columns.reason: An uplift in observer coverage is granted in reaction to the conservation event, so it is not final beforehand.

columns.name: grant_scheme
columns.reason: Subsidy programme participation is a standing administrative attribute.
